name: FmtSpan
docs:
Configures what points in the span lifecycle are logged as events.

See also [`with_span_events`].

[`with_span_events`]: super::SubscriberBuilder::with_span_events
availability: Observed in the hosted capture; reachability is separate from raw visibility. Consumer dependency/features/target must be checked independently.

name: ACTIVE
docs: one event per enter/exit of a span
availability: Observed in the hosted capture; reachability is separate from raw visibility. Consumer dependency/features/target must be checked independently.

name: CLOSE
docs: one event when the span is dropped
availability: Observed in the hosted capture; reachability is separate from raw visibility. Consumer dependency/features/target must be checked independently.

name: ENTER
docs: one event per enter of a span
availability: Observed in the hosted capture; reachability is separate from raw visibility. Consumer dependency/features/target must be checked independently.

name: EXIT
docs: one event per exit of a span
availability: Observed in the hosted capture; reachability is separate from raw visibility. Consumer dependency/features/target must be checked independently.

name: FULL
docs: events at all points (new, enter, exit, drop)
availability: Observed in the hosted capture; reachability is separate from raw visibility. Consumer dependency/features/target must be checked independently.

name: NEW
docs: one event when span is created
availability: Observed in the hosted capture; reachability is separate from raw visibility. Consumer dependency/features/target must be checked independently.

name: NONE
docs: spans are ignored (this is the default)
